metric_families.description: Observed or modelled fraction where increasing fraction directly represents increasing risk.
Fraction representing retained protection, recoverability, or retained integrity where lower values imply greater risk.
Metric already defined on a fixed bounded scale.
metric_families.requirement: Published or predefined scale bounds must exist independently of the assessed case.

metric_families.description: Unbounded count, fold-amplification, population or network quantity.
metric_families.requirement: Must not be min-max normalized using the current corpus. Requires external or domain-justified anchors and transformation.
Requires a predefined stage-propagation rubric independent of individual cases.

rules: Normalization must be selected by metric semantics, not desired score.
Observed corpus minimum and maximum must not automatically become risk anchors.
A maximum observed value is not automatically maximum possible risk.
Saturation at 1.0 requires an explicit upper-anchor justification.
Transformations must be fixed before external validation scoring.
